retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait-driven layout featuring vertical edge-aligned typography and a central geometric emblem against a dark, moody background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a dark, high-contrast portrait of a subject in a dynamic pose, framed by a vertical title on the right margin and a graphic emblem on the left. The lighting creates a strong spotlight effect, isolating the subject from a deep black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical text along the right edge balances the graphic emblem on the left
High-contrast lighting on the subject creates a diagonal movement from top-left to bottom-right
The dark clothing of the subject merges with the negative space of the background
Geometric emblem acts as a secondary focal point to the subject's face
coreInvariants: Vertical orientation of the primary title text along the right-hand margin
High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting on the central figure
Deep black background with a soft vertical light gradient behind the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, medium-close shot, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright geometric emblem on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves left to the emblem, then follows the vertical text down the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the subject, particularly in the upper left and lower right.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and soft white/yellow light
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Olive green or muted gold (emblem background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between deep shadows and bright highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical stacking for the side title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and orientations.
graphicDevices: Circular emblem with internal trident-like crown motif
White rectangular 'hype sticker' overlay in the upper right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric, 80s tech-pop aesthetic.
Provides the necessary squareness and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast studio portrait of a person in a dark shirt against a black background with a soft vertical light beam. Leave the right margin and left center area clear for text and graphics.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a geometric circular emblem on the left. Place uppercase, wide-tracked sans-serif text vertically along the right edge and horizontally below the emblem.

verificationChecks: Is the text on the right edge vertical?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure vertical text is legible and properly spaced
Verify the emblem does not overlap the subject's face
Check that the black levels are deep and consistent
Confirm the 'hype sticker' looks like a separate physical element
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast portrait + vertical edge-aligned wide-tracked sans-serif + geometric emblem = 80s Urban Pop Aesthetic
